TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Reptilian Kingdoms Faction.

Translations.Comment: 爬虫類 (hashuchu-rui) = reptilians, 王国 (ōkoku) = kingdom. Maintains fantasy tone for ancient lizard-men empires.
トカゲ人 (tokage-jin) = saurians/lizard-men, 戦士 (senshi) = warriors. Core troop unit with classic wargame tone.
クロコリスク = Crocolisk (kept as fantasy creature name), 撲滅兵 (bokutsu-hei) = bruiser soldiers. Phonetic adaptation for fantasy creature with heavy warrior emphasis.
イモリ (imori) = newt, 勇者 (yūsha) = brave/hero. Lesser troops with classic fantasy wargame terminology.
トカゲ人 (tokage-jin) = saurians, 槍兵 (sō-hei) = spear infantry. Standard wargame unit type terminology.
ラプター (raputā) = raptor (English loan word), 騎兵 (kiheishi) = cavalry. Fast strike cavalry unit.
翼竜 (yokuryū) = pterodactyl/winged dragon, 騎兵 (kiheishi) = cavalry. Air superiority unit with fantastical tone.
イモリ (imori) = newt, 軽装兵 (keisō-hei) = light infantry/skirmishers. Fast, light troop unit.
火炎 (kaen) = fire, トカゲ (tokage) = lizard. Fire-breathing monster unit with clear fantasy wargame presence.
トリケラトプス = kept as dinosaur name (katakana, scientific terminology). Massive horned beast with iconic status.
ジャングル (janguru) = jungle, 蜂起 (hōki) = swarm/uprising. Depicts coordinated small creature forces from jungle environment.
恐怖 (kyōfu) = dread/terror, 顎 (ago) = maw/jaw. Terrifying predator with formidable presence.
ティラノサウルス = kept as dinosaur name (katakana, scientific terminology). Apex predator and faction's ultimate unit.
イモリ (imori) = newt, 司祭 (shisai) = priest. Religious leader unit using formal wargame terminology.
トカゲ人 (tokage-jin) = saurians, 軍閥 (gunbatsu) = warlord/military faction leader. Powerful commander unit with authority.
古代 (kodai) = ancient, ヒキガエル (hikigaeru) = toad. Mystical amphibian sage with ancient wisdom and power.
